scene.label: Sound familiar?
scene.title: Those restless moments before sleep
scene.desc: Insomnia isn't just being unable to sleep — it's a mind that won't let you rest.
scene.note: It's not that you won't sleep. Your mind needs to be heard.

cards.title: Late-night work anxiety
cards.body: Tomorrow's presentation, rehearsed a hundred times in your head. The longer you lie there, the more awake you get.

cards.title: The harder you try, the worse it gets
cards.body: You check the clock — 2:17 AM. Why won't your brain just power down?

cards.title: Thoughts that won't stop
cards.body: It's not that you don't want to sleep — your mind just won't quit. Past and future, round and round.

product.label: What it is
product.title: What is ZhiMian
product.lead: Not a sleep gadget. Not a pill to knock you out.
product.highlight: A bedtime companion for your mind.
product.body: ZhiMian draws on the core ideas of cognitive behavioral therapy. Through a gentle pre-sleep conversation, it helps you say the noise in your head out loud and set it down — so your mind stops fighting itself.

cards.title: Bedtime chat
cards.body: Talk it out with an AI companion. Saying the worry out loud is what lets the mind finally relax.

cards.title: Sleep diary
cards.body: Three simple questions a day. Let the data show you what's really going on.

cards.title: Sleep nudge
cards.body: Awake after 20 minutes in bed? A gentle prompt to get up and give your brain a reset.

cards.title: Sleep efficiency
cards.body: Set your time in bed scientifically. Weekly summaries make progress visible.

science.title: A science-backed way to handle pre-sleep anxiety
science.body: CBT-I (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia) is a clinically researched intervention for insomnia. ZhiMian draws on its core ideas to offer warm pre-sleep companionship — it does not replace medical diagnosis or treatment.

story.label: Our story
story.title: Where we started
story.quote: It's not that we can't sleep — we just have too much to say before bed, and no one listening.
story.body: ZhiMian started from something simple: people who can't sleep need a place to be heard. Not to be rushed to sleep, but to have their mind cleared. We're not a sleep-medicine startup. We're the support crew for everyone who lies awake.

hero.label: ZHIMIAN FOR HR · Team mental-wellness pulse
hero.title:
A quiet mental-wellness
pulse for your team
hero.tagline: Employees get an AI bedtime companion. You get anonymized team-level insights on stress, sleep, and anxiety trends. See the risk — never the individual.

problem.label: What we solve
problem.title: Mental health is a hidden cost, and EAPs rarely get used
problem.desc: Traditional Employee Assistance Programs see <5% utilization — not because employees don't need help, but because the barrier is too high.

cards.title: Insomnia isn't 'whining'
cards.body: 30-40% of working adults report chronic insomnia. Work stress is the leading trigger. Few will take time off for a clinic visit.

cards.title: Stress shows up too late
cards.body: By the time someone resigns, burns out, or makes mistakes, HR is months behind. You need an early signal, not a postmortem.

cards.title: Employees avoid EAP
cards.body: Fear of being labeled, hurting their career, looking 'fragile'. An anonymous AI removes that barrier entirely.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps, no training required
how.desc: For employees: a bedtime AI companion. For HR: one report per month with the signals that matter.

steps.title: HR uploads the roster
steps.body: Drop a CSV of employee emails. We send invite links and one-time codes. Employees sign up with email + invite.

steps.title: Employees just use it
steps.body: Bedtime chats, worry journaling, sleep tracking — same as the consumer app. The AI doesn't know which company they're in.

steps.title: You get a monthly team report
steps.body: Sleep-efficiency distribution, stress trends, worry themes (work / family / health), crisis event counts — fully team-level aggregated.

privacy.label: Our promise to employees
privacy.title: HR will never see individuals
privacy.desc: This is the most important design choice. Employees will only use it if they trust their employer can't see their details.

points.title: k=5 anonymity floor
points.body: Any team or department metric with fewer than 5 people returns 'insufficient data', not a real number. Small teams roll up to the department level — no individual can ever be backed out.

points.title: Conversation content never leaves
points.body: Everything an employee says to the AI is used only to respond in the moment. HR dashboards never show conversation snippets, worry text, or raw sleep entries.

points.title: Mandatory informed consent
points.body: Employees must explicitly opt-in at first sign-up, with clear language: 'your employer sees aggregate data only, never your identity'. They can leave any time.

points.title: Data residency you control
points.body: Chinese-market clients: data stays in mainland China (GB 18030 + 等保 2.0). International clients: EU / US options available on request, GDPR-aligned.

privacy.crisisTitle: 🚨 On crisis events — we deliberately don't notify HR
privacy.crisisBody: When an employee mentions self-harm or suicide, the AI routes them to professional resources (988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, Crisis Text Line, regional hotlines). HR only sees aggregate counts ('N high-risk events on team Y this month'). This is not a gap — it's the right legal and ethical choice. It keeps employees safe and shields the employer from 'saw it and didn't act' liability.

items.a: Annual per-seat license. First year includes onboarding, customization, and the first monthly report. Detailed pricing (50 / 200 / 500+ seats) — please contact sales.

items.q: What if employees don't want to use it?
items.a: In our experience, 'anonymous + HR doesn't see you' is the key to adoption. We provide an employee-comms template to reduce rollout friction. Clients who don't hit activation targets in year 1 can request a renewal discount.

items.q: Is the data used to train AI models?
items.a: No. Enterprise client data is fully siloed and never enters any AI training set. This is written into every contract.

items.q: Can we integrate with our SSO?
items.a: Day 1: email + invite code. SAML / OIDC / DingTalk / Lark / WeCom — on the V2 roadmap, available for early reservation.

items.q: What happens when an employee leaves?
items.a: One click in your HR console removes them from the org. Their personal data stays available to them as an individual user, but no longer feeds aggregation.
